title: Reviewed annual-return JSON snapshot
description: JSON equivalent of CSV symbol,name,assetClass,year,return records. Policy: complete bundled coverage unless an adjacent manifest explicitly declares a subset; completed calendar years only; no silent filling, correction, normalization or metadata inference. Cross-record consistency and coverage require Phase 2 semantic validation.

year.description: Completed calendar year, not a partial current year; cutoff and unique periods are semantic checks.

return.description: Calendar-year total return with dividends reinvested, last-trading-day to last-trading-day, in decimal units at four-decimal precision; cannot be less than a total loss. ETF presets use ETF-level returns, not index total-return substitutes.
